title: Use of Mattresses in Migrant Worker Dormitories
what_it_is: Use of Mattresses in Migrant Worker Dormitories

sections.label: Dormitory bed provision requirement
sections.summary: Dormitory operators must provide each resident a bed with a bed frame and bed board or mattress.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: All dormitory operators are required to provide each dormitory resident with a bed, which should include a bed frame and a bed board or mattress.

sections.label: Bed complaints and mattress prohibition
sections.summary: Between 2018 and 2022 no worker complaints on beds were received, and MOM investigated 19 related cases.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: The first is that, between the recent years 2018 and 2022, in fact, there were no active complaints received from any worker related to beds, bed boards or mattresses in dormitories.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: Between 2018 and 2022, MOM investigated a total of 19 cases on issues related to beds, bed boards or mattresses at the dormitories.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: At that time, the inspection was for larger dormitories to purpose-built dormitories.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: And I would say that all these inspections were proactive, but none of the cases that were investigated – as I said in my earlier answer of 19 cases being investigated – were related to the prohibition of the usage of mattresses or bed boards.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: One, the migrant workers themselves discarded or misplaced the mattresses or the bed boards because some of them have preferences to sleep on a harder surface or prefer to not use a mattress, because it could be a little bit warm.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: But having engaged the operators, they are aware of what they need to provide to workers when the beds are occupied.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: I just want to reassure the Member that there were actually no cases in which workers were denied the use of mattresses when they chose to do so.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
sentences.text: I visited some migrant worker dormitories recently and none of them had mattresses.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
sentences.text: I asked some of them and I think there is this misconception because they told me that MOM had prohibited the use of mattresses.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: Dormitory residents who feel that they have been told otherwise could either approach our Assurance, Care and Engagement officers who are on the ground, engaging with the dormitory operators, or they could access the feedback channel through the FWMOMCare app, which all workers are able to access and download, and then, they can contact MOM directly to investigate any cases in which they had been prohibited.
